Name: Skill Speed Boost
Author: Jared
Description: Skill progression control: per-skill XP multipliers (0-10x, applied only to XP you earn, never to a perk's starting skill bonus), staleness decay (global or per-skill rate, applied at once when changed in-game), morning and night-owl XP bonuses (for every skill or only the skills you list), area familiarity bonuses with an optional starting floor and an optional fade for places you stop visiting, an optional extra XP bonus at structures you name (your forge, your study desk), an optional season bonus (faster or slower XP for the skills and seasons you name), an optional environment bonus (faster or slower XP in the kinds of place you name, such as any cave), optional tool and action bonuses (faster or slower XP with the tools and from the actions you name), an optional perk bonus (faster or slower XP while you hold a perk you name, set up for Community Mod Chest's Academy graduate perks), an optional day-streak bonus for gaining XP on consecutive days, an optional rested-XP bank (doubled gains for a skill you leave alone for days, spent one per gain), an optional milestone burst (an extra skill point the first time a skill reaches each 25-point breakpoint, once per character), an optional XP overflow (XP a maxed skill cannot take goes, at half by default, to its least trained related skill instead of being lost), an optional on-screen XP readout (a short message near the time wheel naming the XP bonuses that applied, shown when they change), an optional partner setting (the Partner companion's skills take your staleness settings and your global or per-skill XP multiplier; situational bonuses never apply to the Partner), optional per-save progression (area familiarity, the day streak and the rested-XP bank kept separately for each save slot, so a new character does not inherit an old one's), difficulty presets that set the whole stack (Balanced, Casual, Hardcore, Immersive, etc.), skill synergies (combo XP for chaining related skills, with a tunable step, cap and timeout in real or in-game minutes, an option to count only a change of skill, and your own synergy groups, which by default add Community Mod Chest's Melee Fighting to Combat), level-based XP scaling with Linear/EaseIn/EaseOut curves, an optional first-use-of-the-day bonus, an optional well-rested bonus, an optional In the Flow bonus (faster XP while your Focus is in its top band, so anything that raises Focus also speeds learning), an optional low-condition XP penalty for working while exhausted, starving or parched, an optional cap on the combined multiplier, and effective-settings, per-XP-gain and daily per-skill XP summary logs for troubleshooting.
